extracted.name: Japanese-Style Cabbage Salad
extracted.description: This Japanese-style cabbage salad is a healthy slaw with green onion and almonds tossed in a sweet dressing of sesame oil, rice vinegar, and ginger.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 large head cabbage, cored and shredded
instruction_lines: Combine cabbage, green onions, almond, and sesame seeds in a large bowl.
Make dressing: Whisk together sesame oil, vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper in a small bowl until sugar is dissolved.
Pour dressing over cabbage mixture and toss until well combined.
